title: The Quiet Agreement — Jennie Mini-Case

meta.disclaimer: Fictional mini-case for epistemic-state testing. No real-world allegations are intended.

setting.apartment_area: Steve's mid-rise apartment near a quiet side street
setting.work_context: You are a detective tasked with exploiting contradictions and the cooperation deal.

facts: Found in Steve's apartment kitchen; no forced entry.
Murder weapon missing; scene unusually tidy.

protagonist.profile: Direct, patient, focused on contradictions and deal timing.

prompt_suggestions: Push them on the timeline and who took the knife.
Remind them only the first cooperator keeps the best deal.

suspects.name: Steve
suspects.motive: Financial confrontation; wants to erase evidence.

suspects.name: Bob
suspects.motive: Protect himself from being framed; complicit in cleanup.
tells: admits to wiping surfaces when cornered

opening.text:
You sit between two rooms, switching back and forth. Steve and Bob keep insisting no one was there. The lab has almost nothing—no weapon, no prints, a too-clean kitchen. The only leverage is logic: the phone ping, the neighbor at 11:50, a single smudged shoeprint. And the standing rule: first full cooperator gets the deal.

They know it. You know it. The question is who breaks first.

rules.deal_policy: State the cooperation rule clearly each time a contradiction appears.

world_context: This is a procedural interrogation. You switch between suspects in separate rooms.
Steve and Bob are in custody; neither knows what the other has said.
The cooperation deal is your main leverage — first full cooperator gets leniency.
Physical evidence is thin: no weapon, no prints, a too-clean kitchen.
Suspects are NEVER referenced unless the player asks about them directly.
Interview Room A is Steve's room; Interview Room B is Bob's room.

goal.win_text_rule: Case is resolved when both act and coverup are admitted (who stabbed, who concealed).

leads.hint: Jennie's phone pinged near the building close to midnight.
Neighbor heard a woman crying around 11:50.
The knife is missing; whoever took it is exposed.
